verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Izrẹl de mu oyan te ọye te emu ro vwori ejobi, o de rhi te Bẹẹrsheba, o de ze izobo kẹ Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ rọye Aizik.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin izrel de mu oyan te oye te emu ro vwori ejobi o de rhi te beersheba o de ze izobo ke oghene re ose roye aizik

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta ota kẹ Izrẹl vwẹ evwerhẹ vwẹ ason, ọ da ta, Jekọp, Jekọp o de nyo nẹ, Mẹvwẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta ota ke izrel vwe evwerhe vwe ason o da ta jekop jekop o de nyo ne mevwe na

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ọ da ta, Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ, Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn, wọ djẹ oshọ ri wo vwo kpo Ijipt na-a, kidie Me dia oboyin ru we phihọ ẹgborho rode.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin o da ta mevwe oghene oghene re ose wen wo dje osho ri wo vwo kpo ijipt na a kidie me dia oboyin ru we phiho egborho rode

verses.text_urhobo: Me yan nene uwe kpo Ijipt na, Me je vwo we rhivwi rhe, abọ ri Josẹf ki rhurhu we ẹro.
verses.text_romanized: me yan nene uwe kpo ijipt na me je vwo we rhivwi rhe abo ri josef ki rhurhu we ero

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp de vrẹn ni Bẹẹrsheba, emọ rẹ Izrẹl de mu Jekọp rẹ ọsẹ rayen, imitete rayen, kugbe eya rayen, phihọ ekpẹrẹ ri Fero vwọ rhe nẹ vwo muo rhe.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de vren ni beersheba emo re izrel de mu jekop re ose rayen imitete rayen kugbe eya rayen phiho ekpere ri fero vwo rhe ne vwo muo rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen de ji mu uchuru rayen kugbe eyere rayen, re ayen vwori vwẹ otọ ri Kenan, ayen da rhe Ijipt, ti Jekọp vẹ uvwiẹ rọye ejobi,
verses.text_romanized: ayen de ji mu uchuru rayen kugbe eyere rayen re ayen vwori vwe oto ri kenan ayen da rhe ijipt ti jekop ve uvwie roye ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: emọ rọye rẹ emeshare, kugbe emọ rẹ emọ rọye, emetẹ rọye kugbe emọ rẹ emetẹ rọye ejobi, uvwiẹ rọye ejobi vẹ ọye usun re gba rhe Ijipt.
verses.text_romanized: emo roye re emeshare kugbe emo re emo roye emete roye kugbe emo re emete roye ejobi uvwie roye ejobi ve oye usun re gba rhe ijipt

verses.text_urhobo: Enana keye edẹ rẹ uvwiẹ rẹ Izrẹl, re rhe otọ rẹ Ijipt, Jekọp vẹ emọ rọye. Rubẹn rẹ ọwanra,
verses.text_romanized: enana keye ede re uvwie re izrel re rhe oto re ijipt jekop ve emo roye ruben re owanra

verses.text_urhobo: kugbe emọ ri Rubẹn: Hanọk, Pallu, Hezron, vi Karmi.
verses.text_romanized: kugbe emo ri ruben hanok pallu hezron vi karmi

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Simiọn Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, vi Shaul ọmọ rẹ aye rẹ ohwo ri Kenan.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri simion jemuel jamin ohad jakin zohar vi shaul omo re aye re ohwo ri kenan

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Livae; Gẹrshọn, Kohat, vi Merari.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri livae gershon kohat vi merari

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Juda: Ẹr, Ọnan, Shelah, Pẹrẹz, vi Zerah (ẹkẹvuọvo Ẹr vẹ Ọnan de ghwu vwẹ otọ ri Kenan); emọ ri Pẹrẹz ke rha Hezron vi Hamul.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri juda er onan shelah perez vi zerah ekevuovo er ve onan de ghwu vwe oto ri kenan emo ri perez ke rha hezron vi hamul

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ rẹ Isaka: Tola, Puvah, Jashub, kugbe Shimrọn.
verses.text_romanized: emo re isaka tola puvah jashub kugbe shimron

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Zẹbulọn: Serẹd, Elọn, vi Jahleel
verses.text_romanized: emo ri zebulon sered elon vi jahleel

verses.text_urhobo: (enana emọ ri Leah, ro vwiẹ ki Jekọp vwi Padanaram, vi Dinah rẹ ọmọtẹ rọye; ayen ejobi te emeshare vẹ emetẹ rọye da dia ọgban gbẹ erha).
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri leah ro vwie ki jekop vwi padanaram vi dinah re omote roye ayen ejobi te emeshare ve emete roye da dia ogban gbe erha

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Gad: Zifion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, vi Areli.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri gad zifion haggi shuni ezbon eri arodi vi areli

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Asha; Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, vi Serah rẹ oniọvo rọye. Emọ ri Beriah Heber vi Malkiel.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri asha imnah ishvah ishvi beriah vi serah re oniovo roye emo ri beriah heber vi malkiel

verses.text_urhobo: (Enana emọ ri Zilpah, ri Laban vwọ kẹ Leah rẹ ọmọtẹ rọye, enana keye o vwiẹ ki Jekọp ihwe gbẹ esan).
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri zilpah ri laban vwo ke leah re omote roye enana keye o vwie ki jekop ihwe gbe esan

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Rachel, rẹ aye ri Jekọp: Josẹf kugbe Bẹnjamin.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri rachel re aye ri jekop josef kugbe benjamin

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ obo otọ rẹ Ijipt Josẹf de vwiẹ Manasse kugbe Ifrem, rẹ Asenath, rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Potifera re orherẹn ri On, vwiẹ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: vwe obo oto re ijipt josef de vwie manasse kugbe ifrem re asenath re omote ri potifera re orheren ri on vwie ke

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Bẹnjamin: Bẹla, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, vẹ Ard
verses.text_romanized: emo ri benjamin bela becher ashbel gera naaman ehi rosh muppim huppim ve ard

verses.text_urhobo: (enana emọ ri Rachel, ro vwiẹ ki Jekọp - ayen ejobi ihwo ihwẹne).
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri rachel ro vwie ki jekop ayen ejobi ihwo ihwene

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Dan: Hushim.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri dan hushim

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Naftali Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, vi Shillem
verses.text_romanized: emo ri naftali jahzeel guni jezer vi shillem

verses.text_urhobo: (enana emọ ri Bilhah, ri Laban vwọ ki Rachel ọmọtẹ rọye, enana keye o rhe vwiẹ ki Jekọp - ayen ihwo ighwrẹ).
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri bilhah ri laban vwo ki rachel omote roye enana keye o rhe vwie ki jekop ayen ihwo ighwre

verses.text_urhobo: Ihwo ejobi ri Jekọp vwori re rhe otọ rẹ Ijipt, re dia emọ rẹ orhẹn rọye, e kere eya rẹ emọ ri Jekọp kugbe-e, ayen ejobi da dia ujorha gbẹ esan;
verses.text_romanized: ihwo ejobi ri jekop vwori re rhe oto re ijipt re dia emo re orhen roye e kere eya re emo ri jekop kugbe e ayen ejobi da dia ujorha gbe esan

verses.text_urhobo: emọ ri Josẹf, ro vwiẹri vwẹ Ijipt, da dia ivẹ, ihwo rẹ uwevwi ri Jekọp ejobi re rhe otọ rẹ Ijipt da dia ujorha gbẹ ihwe.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri josef ro vwieri vwe ijipt da dia ive ihwo re uwevwi ri jekop ejobi re rhe oto re ijipt da dia ujorha gbe ihwe

verses.text_urhobo: O de ji Juda ka obaro bru Josẹf, rere o re dje idjerhe ri Goshẹn ke ayen, ayen de rhi te otọ ri Goshẹn.
verses.text_romanized: o de ji juda ka obaro bru josef rere o re dje idjerhe ri goshen ke ayen ayen de rhi te oto ri goshen

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf da rhuẹrẹ idjighere rọye ọ da ra vwa Izrẹl ọsẹ rọye vwi Goshẹn: ọ da vwẹ oma nẹ, o da gbanọ ohọre, ọ da viẹ kuo ohọre krekri.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef da rhuere idjighere roye o da ra vwa izrel ose roye vwi goshen o da vwe oma ne o da gbano ohore o da vie kuo ohore krekri

verses.text_urhobo: Izrẹl da ta ki Josẹf, Asakiephana gbe ju vwe ghwu, re Me vwọ mrẹ opharo wẹn nure na, Me ke rha riẹn nẹ wọ je akpọ.
verses.text_romanized: izrel da ta ki josef asakiephana gbe ju vwe ghwu re me vwo mre opharo wen nure na me ke rha rien ne wo je akpo

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da ta kẹ emesẹ rọye, kugbe evwruwevwi rayen, Me yanran re Me ra vuẹ Fero, re Me ta kẹ nẹ, Ọsẹ mẹ vẹ emesẹ mẹ vẹ evwruwevwi rayen ejobi, re otọ ri Kenan bru vwe rhe,
verses.text_romanized: josef da ta ke emese roye kugbe evwruwevwi rayen me yanran re me ra vue fero re me ta ke ne ose me ve emese me ve evwruwevwi rayen ejobi re oto ri kenan bru vwe rhe

verses.text_urhobo: ihwo na ichuru igodẹ ayen ruẹ, kidie uchuru ayen churẹ, ayen je ghwa uchuru rayen rhe, te eranvwe rayen, kugbe obo rẹ ayen vwori ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: ihwo na ichuru igode ayen rue kidie uchuru ayen chure ayen je ghwa uchuru rayen rhe te eranvwe rayen kugbe obo re ayen vwori ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Fero de se we, rọ da tanẹ, Didi iruo ovwan ruẹ?
verses.text_romanized: oke ri fero de se we ro da tane didi iruo ovwan rue

verses.text_urhobo: ku wo tanẹ, Idibo wẹn eranvwe ichurẹ nẹ ọke-emọ rhe ri te ọke na, te avwanre te ese rẹ avwanre, rere wa mrasa dia otọ ri Goshẹn na, kidie osuigodẹ kosuigodẹ ẹgua kẹ ihwo rẹ Ijipt.
verses.text_romanized: ku wo tane idibo wen eranvwe ichure ne oke emo rhe ri te oke na te avwanre te ese re avwanre rere wa mrasa dia oto ri goshen na kidie osuigode kosuigode egua ke ihwo re ijipt

headings.text_urhobo: Jekọp vẹ Ekru ọye mu Oyan Kpo Ijipt
headings.text_romanized: jekop ve ekru oye mu oyan kpo ijipt

headings.text_urhobo: Jekọp vẹ Ekru Rọye vwẹ Ijipt
headings.text_romanized: jekop ve ekru roye vwe ijipt
